description: This file contains unit tests for Azure Queue Storage operations within the Orleans framework, focusing on message handling, visibility timeouts, and queue management.

classes.name: AzureQueueDataManagerTests
classes.description: Test class for Azure Queue Storage management operations, including message addition, peeking, retrieval, and deletion tests with different scenarios.

methods.name: AzureQueueDataManagerTests
methods.description: Constructor that sets up logging and verifies Azure Storage availability.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous initialization tasks before tests.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up resources, deletes the test queue if it exists.

methods.name: GetTableManager
methods.description: Initializes and returns an AzureQueueDataManager instance with specified queue name and optional visibility timeout.

methods.name: AQ_Standalone_1
methods.description: Tests basic message enqueue, peek, dequeue, and delete operations, verifying message count and content integrity.

methods.name: AQ_Standalone_2
methods.description: Tests multiple message enqueue and subsequent batch deletion, verifying message count consistency.

methods.name: AQ_Standalone_3_Init_MultipleThreads
methods.description: Tests concurrent initialization of the queue manager across multiple threads.

methods.name: AQ_Standalone_4
methods.description: Tests message visibility timeout behavior by retrieving a message, waiting for the timeout to expire, and retrieving again before deletion.

methods.name: PrintQueueMessage
methods.description: Utility to output detailed information about queued messages for debugging.
